name: sgetmask
description: sgetmask is an obsolete system call that returns the signal mask of the calling process. It deals with plain bit masks and is not recommended for use; instead, use sigprocmask(2).
bugs: These system calls are unaware of signal numbers greater than 31 (real-time signals); they do not exist on x86-64; it is not possible to block SIGSTOP or SIGKILL.
